ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity white to 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions on both lobes; thick black continuous border along the trailing edge and tips; central dark pigmentation cluster consisting of vertical streaks and horizontal banding radiating from the peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees with significant vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Fine-to-moderate serration along the entire trailing edge; increased frequency and amplitude (approx. 5-10 pixel depth) of peaks towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Isolated dark punctate clusters visible on the lower-left and lower-right quadrants of the white ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct series of parallel, dark vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) concentrated in the central white field above the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent rake marks (orca tooth scars) in the central region; multiple irregular notches and minor tissue loss along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'cross-hatch' pigmentation pattern located in the lower-central region near the notch.
